[PREFERENCE] User has changed Max's diet to a grain-free kibble.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant thinks adding a fish oil supplement can be beneficial for Max's coat, skin, and overall health.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The recommended dosage of fish oil for dogs is approximately 100-200 mg of combined EPA and DHA per 10 lbs of body weight for small breeds, 200-400 mg for medium breeds, and 400-600 mg for large breeds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Max, who is assumed to be around 40-50 lbs, a starting point of 200-300 mg of combined EPA and DHA per day is suggested.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When choosing a fish oil supplement, the assistant recommends looking for products specifically formulated for dogs, with a balanced ratio of EPA and DHA, made from high-quality sources, and from reputable companies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advises to introduce new supplements slowly and monitor Max for any adverse reactions.
